resources.string: On your computer, open Settings → Privacy → My phone. Scan the Android companion QR shown there.
Point the camera at the QR shown by Kvieta
Continue only with the invitation displayed on your own computer. The connection will share its usage summary after approval there.
Could not get an updated summary. Check your internet connection and that Kvieta is running on the computer. Local pairing still requires the same Wi-Fi.
Access was denied or the invitation expired. Check the device clocks and create a new invitation.
This invitation is invalid or expired. Use a new invitation from the computer.
Compare this code with the computer. Approve there only if both match.
The dashboard refreshes automatically. Remote summaries and time decisions work on mobile data or another Wi-Fi while Kvieta is running on the computer.
This deletes the phone’s connection and device key. Remove the phone from the computer’s sharing window too before pairing again.
Last recorded state: on a break
Last recorded state: time used up
Last recorded state: outside allowed hours
